# FindaPilot

> > FindaPilot is the premier aviation job board and pilot directory connecting professional pilots with charter, corporate, helicopter, and specialty aviation employment opportunities.

FindaPilot.com is a comprehensive pilot recruitment platform founded by Steve Janos, based in McKinney, TX. The site serves as a centralized job board for aviation careers, offering pilot job listings, career advice, and industry networking for commercial and specialty aviation professionals.

## Key Topics

- Pilot Jobs
- Charter Pilot Positions
- Corporate Aviation
- Captain Roles
- PIC/SIC Requirements
- Part 135 Operations
- Aircraft Types (Gulfstream, Challenger, Hawker, Embraer)
- Pilot Directory
- Aviation Employment
- Job Board
- Pilot Recruitment
- Commercial Pilot Careers
- Helicopter Pilot Jobs
- Career Advice
- Pilot Hiring

## Core Platform

- [FindaPilot Homepage](https://www.findapilot.com): FindaPilot homepage: pilot job board, directory, and aviation career platform
- [Pilot Jobs & Search](https://www.findapilot.com/jobs): Main pilot job search and employment listings board for aviation careers
- [Pilot Directory](https://www.findapilot.com/pilots): Pilot job board with search, directory, and career advice for aviation professionals
- [About FindaPilot](https://www.findapilot.com/about): About FindAPilot.com: pilot job board founded by Steve Janos
